notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
It's been a little over 2000 days since Alkali began development. It's time for an anniversary patch!

[list]
[*] Added machinegun turrets
[*] Added rubber tiles
[*] Added player costumes
[*] Added additional gauntlet levels under the custom campaign
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Added additional gauntlet levels under the custom campaign

notes.title: 6 Month Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Now includes the full alpha campaign under custom content and a world with special stages. 

[b]Patch notes 1.0.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Added alpha version campaign under Custom Campaigns
[*] Added a world with gauntlet levels under Custom Campaigns
[*] Adjusted some sprites
[*] Combined many sprites into larger sprite sheets, improving load times
[*] Corrected visual effects for cracked semisolids
[*] Corrected campaign cutscenes being played in custom campaigns
[*] Overworld preview images updates when reloading custom campaigns, instead of using the cached version
[*] Added a alpha campaign shader (pixelized 16-bit color filter)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Cutscene replay
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added cutscene replay function. Press dash key when standing over a level that normally triggers a cutscene when completed
[*] Select and Cutscene navigation symbol only appears when relevant in overworld
[*] Fixed world 3 intro cutscene
[*] Fixed world 4 intro cutscene
[*] Fixed Ending C  cutscene
[*] Fixed issue with cutscene volume sometimes being too low
[*] Fixed rare visual artifact on player sprite
[*] Improved visibility of glass
[*] Adjusted switch visual size
[*] Made cutscene volume higher to match normal music volume
[*] Fixed issue with marathon achievement not updating 
[/list]
